bills.title: Treasury Laws Amendment (Modernising Business Communications and Other Measures) Bill 2023

name: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2023-09-04.211.1) introduced by Tasmanian Senator [Nick McKim](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/tasmania/nick_mckim) (Greens), which means it failed. The amendment would have introduced provision related to continuous disclosure obligations into the bill.
